warrant_number.description: The search warrant number (SW No.), usually handwritten or stamped at the top right.

judicial_district.description: Judicial district written beside the judge's signature, if any.

affiant.description: The officer who swore the affidavit.

name.description: Name of the affiant as printed in the affidavit.

hobbs_sealing_requested.description: True if the affiant marked YES for Hobbs sealing requested.

night_search_requested.description: True if the affiant marked YES for night search requested.

grounds.description: The statutory grounds (Penal Code 1524) marked with an X. Include only the marked ones.

items.description: The text of a marked ground.

search_scope.description: What the warrant commands to be searched, as printed after 'COMMANDED TO SEARCH'.

issuance.description: Where the magistrate signs and issues the warrant.

issuing_judge.description: Printed name of the magistrate or judge.

judge_title.description: Title printed under the judge's name.

date_issued.description: Date the warrant was sworn and issued (YYYY-MM-DD).

time_issued.description: Time of issuance with a.m. or p.m.

hobbs_sealing_approved.description: True if YES is marked for Hobbs sealing in the issuance section.

night_search_approved.description: True if YES is marked for night search approved.
